app_name: SarkariPYQ Hub - Official Competitive Exam PDF Library
context: A complete exam preparation portal for Indian government competitive examinations including UPSC, BPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC, RAS, Banking, Railways, Defence and Police. The platform provides structured category and exam browsing, year-wise previous year question papers, official PDF viewing and downloading, bookmarking, advanced search and a secure Admin Management System.
archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth) combined with Organization

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800

key_features: Complete bilingual support with English and Hindi language switcher
Responsive homepage with organized category and exam sections
Category-wise and exam-wise previous year question paper browsing
Official PDF links with in-browser preview and download options
Advanced search by exam name, category, year, subject and language
Bookmarks and saved papers with browser local storage persistence
Admin authentication with secure password hashing and JWT-based sessions
Admin dashboard for managing categories, exams and question papers
Upload or add PDF URLs for previous year papers
Paper details including exam name, year, subject, language and paper title
Form validation and meaningful error messages
Mobile, tablet and desktop responsive layout
security: Use JWT authentication for admin routes
Configure CORS for authorized frontend origins
Never expose database credentials or secret keys in frontend code

requirements: No dependency on Emergent-specific packages or services
Frontend and backend must communicate through configurable API URLs
All API endpoints must work after deployment
Production build must complete without errors

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, production-ready full-stack application named SarkariPYQ Hub using React, FastAPI and MongoDB. Follow this design specification carefully. Implement a professional, organized and responsive exam preparation portal with English and Hindi support, category-wise exam browsing, year-wise PYQ papers, PDF preview and download, advanced search, bookmarks and a fully functional secure admin dashboard. Ensure all frontend components are connected to working backend APIs and MongoDB collections. Implement proper loading states, validation, error handling and empty states. Use environment variables for API configuration and secrets. Do not use Emergent-specific dependencies or services. Test frontend builds, API endpoints, authentication, database operations and all major user flows before considering the project complete. Do not use fake success messages or non-functional buttons.
